prompt:
Create one vertical 3:4 photographic portrait of a distinct new fictional, clearly adult East Asian woman, age 21, sitting quietly on a dark brown upholstered bench in a softly sunlit vintage room. She wears an ivory satin slip dress with thin straps and delicate floral lace along a shallow neckline. Her dark hair is loosely pinned up, with untidy long strands falling across her bowed face. She looks down toward a small red flower held gently over her lap. Give her a petite, light adult frame, moderately narrow relaxed shoulders and naturally full covered curves, with balanced adult head-to-shoulder proportions. Preserve the close, seated composition and contemplative gesture, not a fashion-catalog stance.

Fidelity to twelve written relationships is the highest priority: (1) The vertical 3:4 frame shows the crown, torso, lap, bent knees and partial shins, with the woman predominantly on the right. (2) Her head inclines downward and slightly to image left, with lowered eyes and quietly resting lips. (3) Dark hair is gathered into a loose imperfect updo at the back, with wispy strands over the forehead and a longer curtain over part of the cheek. (4) The ivory dress has fine shoulder straps, a shallow softly scalloped floral-lace neckline and a fitted, securely opaque bodice. (5) The satin skirt folds across the lap and falls around the knees, with uneven vertical creases rather than a perfect smooth drape. (6) Both forearms travel diagonally down toward image left; the hands rest close together over the lap, gently holding one small bright red flower. (7) The shoulders are relaxed and lightly rounded, the adult torso is compact, and the natural covered chest-to-waist line remains softly readable. (8) The bent knees project toward the lower left while her seated weight is supported by the dark brown bench at image right. (9) Warm sunlight from image left and front lights the forehead, shoulder, forearms and dress, with a fine hazy glow rather than harsh flash. (10) Muted gray-beige botanical wallpaper sits above reddish dark wooden wall paneling. (11) A rectangular mirror in the upper-left background reflects small framed pictures and subdued room shapes. (12) The small red blossom near her hands is the main saturated accent, balanced by a fragment of another red flower at the far lower-right edge.

Face and hair: Make an independent adult individual with a gently rounded oval face, soft cheek volume, a small rounded chin and a smooth adult jaw transition. The lowered lids and partially obscured eyes should look calm, with naturally shaped brows and no exaggerated large eyes. Use a modest nose bridge, a softly rounded nose tip, a natural nose-to-lip distance and muted rosy lips resting lightly together. The face is angled down in three-quarter profile, without a direct gaze or added smile. Refined restrained East Asian beauty-editorial styling should come through the specific soft facial relationships, not deep eye sockets, carved cheekbones or an oversized angular nose. Keep adult structure and natural proportions. The warm light softens the cheek and forehead but leaves their volume readable; lightly even the complexion while retaining delicate skin microtexture, natural eyelid detail and subtle lip texture. Avoid doll-like smoothing, a pointed chin, childlike proportions, chalk-white skin or exaggerated makeup.

Her hair is deep black-brown and loosely gathered high toward the back into an irregular, softly bulky knot. The top is not perfectly sleek, with a few lifted wisps and small highlights. Long separated front strands fall across the forehead, nose-side and cheek, partly hiding her expression. Keep this slightly uncombed private-moment hairstyle, with a soft uneven part rather than an exact center line. Do not replace it with polished curls, a short bob, a tight ceremonial bun, ornaments or a bridal veil.

Dress and natural shape: The garment is a simple ivory satin slip, softly luminous with pale cream and faint cool-gray folds. Thin matching straps sit naturally on the shoulders. The neckline is shallow and gently curved, edged with a delicate narrow floral lace panel; its lace pattern should be plausible and irregular enough to feel like fabric. Preserve the fine lace appearance while keeping intimate areas securely covered by the opaque body of the dress. The dress fits softly through the bodice and waist, following naturally full adult proportions without arbitrary enlargement or flattening. Its natural contour is created by the shaped fit, slightly forward seated posture, small folds near the waist, and side-lit satin. Do not broaden the chest or ribcage to create fullness. Keep shoulders and upper arms light, the neck relaxed and the waist naturally placed, without extreme narrowing or an unnaturally tiny torso. The skirt is knee length, with the hem and folds interrupted by the bent knees. No added thigh slit, deep neckline, corset hardware, formal gown structure, sleeves or jewelry.

Pose and contact: Her hips rest on the bench with a slight forward inclination from the waist, and the upper body remains softly rounded rather than rigidly upright. Both shoulders release downward. Her upper arms stay near her torso; the forearms extend diagonally across the lap toward image left. The hands meet naturally near the knees, holding a thin flower stem or supporting the bloom without an exaggerated gesture. Show believable knuckles, gentle finger curvature and exactly plausible hand anatomy; do not spread the fingers toward the camera. The red flower sits just beyond the hands to image left, its compact irregular petals catching warm light. The knees bend toward the lower left and the partial shins leave the bottom edge; preserve natural leg length and perspective. Feet and footwear remain outside the crop. Do not reposition her into a frontal body display or move the camera to an intimate low angle.

Room and camera: Use a natural slightly elevated seated portrait viewpoint, close enough that the person fills the frame while keeping the wall and mirror as context. The bench is dark chocolate-brown leather or similar smooth upholstery with a muted shine at its corner. A warm reddish-brown wooden wainscot crosses the lower wall, with simple rectangular molding. Above it is desaturated gray-beige wallpaper with soft botanical leaf motifs. The upper-left mirror has a restrained rectangular frame and reflects a few small pictures and dark indistinct furniture shapes; do not create a second sharply defined person in it. A small pale wall plate may sit to the mirror's left. The room is gently lived-in rather than redesigned into a luxury set. The partial red flower on the seat at the extreme lower right remains a secondary accent, not a bouquet. Do not add readable signage, captions or location names.

Light, mood and finish: Warm window-like sunlight comes from left/front, creating a glowing band on the face, collarbone, near forearm, knees and ivory satin. Keep the shadow side of the upper arm and room darker so the body and dress retain depth. A delicate veil of optical diffusion blooms around the highlights and softens the background, with fine photographic grain; it must not erase the eyes, lace edge, fingers or petal shapes. The palette is warm ivory, subdued skin, brown wood and upholstery, gray botanical wallpaper, black hair and the single vivid red accent. The visual attraction comes from adult composure, the bowed gaze, the gentle hand-to-flower contact, the soft fitted dress and the quiet directional light. Let her expression and the small red flower share attention, with the covered silhouette supporting the scene instead of dominating it. Preserve a candid, thoughtful pause, not a smile or theatrical seduction.

Render at native vertical 3:4 without stretching or upscaling. Reorganize only peripheral space to retain the crown, hands, flower and bent knees within the portrait frame. Keep coherent anatomy, adult facial structure, realistic fabric tension, satin folds, secure non-explicit coverage and grounded contact shadows. Remove third-party marks, account IDs, logos, watermarks, captions and interface elements. Do not generate text or a watermark in the clean image.
